Contentexpand_moreexpand_lessLearning objectives and content
    ObjectivesAcquiring knowledge and insight in theories and methods which play a fundamental role in understanding stochastic financial and insurance models. Being able to implement a stochastic simulation for all the models discussed in the course.

 

    Content1. Random variables and transform methods (several important probability distributions, and their generating function or Laplace transform).

2. Sums of random variables (their distribution and transform); limit theorems (law of large numbers, central limit theorem).

3. The Poisson process, compound Poisson process; random sums of random variables.

4. The multiplicative model and the Lognormal distribution.

5. Basic simulation for financial models and insurance models is treated in the programming language Python.



IMPORTANT 
This course is not meant for bachelor students in Applied Mathematics.
They are recommended to follow the course Stochastic Simulation (2WB50) instead.

This course will be taught for the last time in the academic year 2024-2025. From 2025-2026 onwards, this course will be replaced by a new course which will be similar, but with a broader focus and applications not just limited to finance. Stochastic simulation and practical applications will still play an important role in this new course. Just like 2DF20, the new course will not be aimed at Applied Mathematics students.





A special feature of the course is that, next to theory, there is considerable attention for practice: 
Active use of real data
 
Actual implementation of all models
 
Lecture notes on programming in Python
 
Two assignments, to be made in pairs, using real data and real implementations

Similarly, the stock market contains many random features, and knowledge of stochastic processes is needed to operate effectively in financial markets.In this course, we present  methods that are relevant for the analysis of financial models and insurance modelsCourse enrolmentexpand_moreexpand_less    OSIRIS StudentYou can register yourself via OSIRIS Student.
